annotations.title: Plan eSIMs for a multi-country trip

description: Use this when one trip visits SEVERAL countries, e.g. "Italy then Greece", "two weeks in Japan and Korea". Compares one GlobalPass regional pass that works in all of them with a separate plan per country, and returns both with prices and links to buy. For a single country call search_plans.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Defaults to PLN for Polish and EUR otherwise.

language.description: The traveller's language: en, pl or ru.

stops.description: Every country of the trip, with the days spent in each when known.
